# Context Pack: `sprint-planning-chain` — Sprint planning stage chain Target: ultraplan-go @ 8eef70f4903b25580719960009a170945bdad9ad (frozen). Planning context: ultraplan-workspace @ ab12dc38059c9bf485f9aced9075bcd7d924cac5. Domain: governed-sprint-delivery. Risk: high. Descriptive only — no defect judgments. ## 1. Purpose Governed, ordered generation of seven planning artifacts through agent-runtime calls: ``` requirements.md -> code-context.md -> sprint-index.md -> technical-handbook.md -> reasoning/*.md (per selected area) -> reasoning.md -> plan.md ``` Mechanisms implemented on top of the chain: - **Byte-stable shared prompt prefix** (`maxSharedPromptPrefixBytes` = 512 KiB, prompt_context.go:20): governance text + sprint identity + exact requirements.md bytes + exact code-context.md bytes + transiently resolved source evidence, terminated by one `<<< ULTRAPLAN STAGE-SPECIFIC INSTRUCTIONS BEGIN >>>` boundary (prompts.go:22-33). Every downstream agent call composes `prefix + stage suffix` (prompt_context.go:133-156). - **TOCTOU replacement detection** on every source read: per-component `Lstat` symlink rejection, `EvalSymlinks` containment, open-handle `SameFile` identity checks before/after read, size+mtime equality, canonical-location stability (readSharedSource prompt_context.go:346-420, verifySharedSourceUnchanged :422). - **Per-stage content validators** (pure functions of content + manifests/catalog) used for gating, skip decisions, and repair prompts. - **Bounded repair**: one product-side in-session repair attempt (`generatedArtifactRepairAttempts = 1`, runtime_validation.go:12) after the run; independently, artifact-writing stages attach an agentwrap `ValidationSpec` whose `RepairConfig.MaxAttempts = 2` with fresh-session fallback at attempt ≥2 (runtime_validation.go:127-143). - **Candidate-temp promotion** for code-context: write `.code-context.*.candidate.md`, validate, `os.Rename` over the artifact, restore prior bytes if flow-state persist fails (promoteCodeContext code_context.go:457-506). - **Worktree creation**: first code-context resolution creates a Git worktree `ultraplan//` branch at `/.-ultraplan-worktrees//`, recorded in `/.workspace.json` (execute_target.go:136-181). - **Stage-session checkpoints** in `/.stage-sessions.json` enabling interrupted-session continuation (session_state.go). ## 2. Entrypoints and control flow ### CLI (`internal/app/sprint_commands.go`) - Dispatch `runSprint` (:28). Subcommands over `sprint.NewService(root)` (:88, publisher/stage-runtime/smoke settings wired; no runtime attached for read-only paths): - `status [--json]` (:90) → `Service.Status`. - `validate ` (:142) → `Validate`; exit `ExitValidation` when invalid. - `prompt [--explain]` (:180) → `Prompt`; prints prompt or JSON `PromptExplanation` + `InputContract`. - `flow [--to ] [--dry-run] [--model] [--variant] [--stage-model==] [--stage-variant=...]` plus review/smoke flags (:223, parser :1003). Non-dry-run requires `--yes` only for smoke (:233); wraps in `beginDurableCLICommand` (accept-before-execute run-control row, cancellation-aware ctx, `finishDurableCLICommand`) and rebuilds the service with a controlled runtime via `sprintRuntimeService` (:685). Error mapping `mapSprintError` (:944): canceled→ExitCancel, conflict→ExitPartial, malformed state→ExitValidation, ref errors→ExitValidation, default→ExitWorkspace; findings-bearing failures→ExitValidation; "runtime"-string errors→ExitRuntime (:269). - Single-stage durable operations (web/TUI) call `Service.FlowStage` (operation_runner.go:27, operations.go:435 dry-run). ### Service state machine (`internal/sprint/flow.go`) - `Flow` (:92): `flowStages(target)` (:257) yields the canonical prefix 1..8 (7 planning stages + execute; review/smoke targets also run all 8 then `Verify`). DryRun: single target stage only; review/smoke dry-run delegates to `Verify(DryRun:true)`. Non-dry: `resolveSprintForRequirements(create=true)` materializes the sprint skeleton **before** lease acquisition (:108-115), then `acquireMutationContext` (:117). - Per stage: emit progress → if already valid (`flowStageAlreadyValid` :284, validator-based; code-context uses `codeContextPrerequisite`; execute uses `ExecuteComplete`) → clear that stage's saved session checkpoint (:142-146), publish, emit "skipped", continue; else `runFlowStage` (:226) → on success publish (`publishPlanningStage`) → next stage. First failure returns immediately with persisted failed-state. - `FlowStage` (:189): exactly one planning stage, prerequisites preserved, no earlier scheduling; publishes after success. - `runFlowStage` dispatch (:226-246): FlowRequirements, FlowCodeContext, FlowSprintIndex, FlowTechnicalHandbook, FlowReasoning (area or final), FlowPlan, Execute(Resume). ### Common non-dry stage shape 1. `resolveSprintInputsForFlow` (service.go:956): DiscoverProjects→ResolveProject→DiscoverSprints→ResolveSprint (exact then unique-prefix; skeleton creation only for unambiguous RefError) → containment check `inside(p.Path, sp.Path)` → `ReadPlanningInputs` (store_fs.go:95: requirements required; code-context/sprint-index optional-missing-ok; project-index.md required; sorted docs list) → `ParseProjectIndex` must produce zero findings. 2. Prerequisite validation per stage (requirements content; code-context prerequisite = artifact valid **and** flow-state shows code-context complete, code_context.go:237; sprint-index/handbook/reasoning/plan manifests built from catalog + prior artifacts). 3. Render stage prompt (prompts.go): base body from workspace override → builtin default (`renderPromptFromDefault` :219; reasoning defaults resolve project→workspace→builtin, :259); injected template files; "Hard constraints" block; Runtime Manifest; then `appendDirectInputPacket` (direct_inputs.go:187) copying governed inputs **in full**, wrapped in `<<< BEGIN/END ULTRAPLAN DIRECT INPUT >>>` blocks with ID/Kind/Path/Mode/Original-Bytes headers; missing inputs listed with reasons redacted to `[workspace]` (:217). 4. `composeSharedRuntimePrompt` (persistCache=true): `prepareSharedPromptContext` (prompt_context.go:93) loads the cached pack (identity-keyed) or renders live; suffix appended after the boundary. 5. `runtimeRequest` (service.go:1122): base config request; WorkDir=workspace root (code-context later overrides WorkDir to the target worktree, code_context.go:306); metadata (project/sprint/stage/task/coverage/area/output_path/candidate_path/target_source/model_source/variant_source/trace_id/prompt checksums/input-contract list); scoped `RuntimeStoreOwner/Path`; `CacheDirective{Mode:"stable-prefix"}` when explanation says cacheable; per-stage model/variant from `planningStageRuntime(config)` (app :894) merged with `withStageOverrides` (service.go:195). 6. `startPlanningStageRun` (session_state.go:105): checkpoint lookup; compatible record (same provider+model+workDir; prompt checksum diagnostic-only, :87) → continue session with continuation instruction inserted right after the boundary (:173); `OnEvent` persists new session IDs best-effort (mutex-deduped); on "session not found" string match across err/output/attempts (:158) → clear key, restart fresh with original prompt. 7. `startSprintRuntime` (runtime_metrics.go:116): `CleanupRuntimeStores(sp.Path, 72h, 2GiB)`; `StartRun`; append record to `.runtime-metrics.json` (atomic, cap 512). 8. Post-run: status must be ""|success|complete|completed; code-context additionally requires `Permissions.UnsupportedCount == 0`; read artifact back from disk; validate; if findings and SessionID ≠ "" → one `repairGeneratedArtifact` (continue session, findings-derived repair prompt, service.go:1197) then re-validate; remaining findings → failed state persisted. Success: compute full success `StageStates` (flow.go:324-383; encodes next-stage Ready and Skipped propagation when `NoTemplates`), `SaveFlowState(NewFlowState(...))`, `cleanupPlanningStageSessions` (delete runtime store/session + remove checkpoint; errors discarded), return. ### Code-context specifics (`code_context.go`) - `FlowCodeContext` (:257): validated requirements + resolvable target mandatory; candidate temp created in sprint dir (:282, removed via defer); runtime sandbox `"read_only"`, permissions `"restricted"` with allow-list {read,glob,search,list} and `RequireCaps:["permissions"]` (:307-310); output content = TerminalOutput else last event content field (:401); validated twice (content + `validateResolvedCodeContext` dry-render of the shared prefix to prove every reference resolves, :391); candidate re-read and re-validated after write; prefix rendered and cached (best-effort) **before** promotion; `promoteCodeContext` renames and rolls back on persist failure (:457); success marks sprint-index Ready. - Target/worktree: `resolveSprintTarget(create)` (execute_target.go:56): `**Target Implementation Directory:**` extracted from user project-index (:229); existing `.workspace.json` validated (source-root match, dir exists, git-common-dir identity, current branch match, :99); else `createSprintWorkspace` (:136) requires clean source worktree root, records baseline HEAD, creates branch + worktree, atomically writes record; record-write failure removes worktree and branch (:176-178). `Flow`'s already-valid code-context path re-checks workspace creation findings (flow.go:133-141). ### Shared prefix rendering (`prompt_context.go:158`) Order: `sharedPromptInstructions` → `Project:/Sprint:` identity → framed exact requirements → framed exact code-context → framed source evidence → boundary. References parsed from the validated "Selected Source References" section (:283); ranges parsed (positive N or N-M, :307), merged/canonicalized per file (:230). Per selection: remaining-budget computation; containment + symlink-free + regular-file + handle-identity + UTF-8 + range-bounds + unchanged checks; framed as `UNTRUSTED TRANSIENT SOURCE EVIDENCE`; running total checked against 512 KiB including closer+boundary (:196, :213, :221). Any failure is a typed `promptContextError` (kinds: invalid_path, containment, file_kind, missing_source, invalid_range, changed_during_read, invalid_encoding, budget_exceeded, :24-35) with diagnostics that avoid absolute implementation-root leakage (:70). ### Context pack cache (`context_pack.go`) Key = sha256("sprint-context-v1\x00"+reqDigest+"\x00"+ccDigest+"\x00"+targetDigest) (:34); stored at `/.ultra/cache/sprint-context///.json` (:47). Load verifies schema/project/sprint/key/all digests, prefix digest, boundary suffix, and size cap (:61-66); mismatch → treated as miss. Save refuses invalid payloads, writes atomically, prunes to 8 newest by mtime (:91). Both directions are non-authoritative: read failure falls back to live render; write failure is ignored (prompt_context.go:110-122). ### State authorities (`state.go`, `state_database.go`) - `LoadFlowState` (:20): SQLite mirror first (productstate kind `sprint_flow`, scope `p/s`); else JSON `flow-state.json` schemaVersion 2 (v1 migrated; pre-code-context 6-stage layouts interpreted with an inserted code-context stage, :74/:96). Strict decode (DisallowUnknownFields, trailing-value rejection), `ValidateFlowState` (:294: exact stage list/order, valid statuses, contained paths, sanitized error text, outcome enum). - `SaveFlowState` (:201): preserves prior Review/Smoke/QA records; DB-authoritative when a mirror row exists (JSON checkpoint then written only for all-terminal stage states, :233); otherwise atomic fsync+rename JSON write (:242-292). - `DeriveStages` (service.go:1484): artifact-presence derivation with code-context requiring prior complete status; area-reasoning derived from `reasoning/` contents or explicit no-selection; first Missing stage becomes Ready; prior Failed preserved as blocker. `Status()` (:229) derives and (unless `WithoutStatusWrites`) saves refreshed state. ## 3. Inputs / outputs Inputs: argv; env/config (models, variants, timeouts via `RequestFromConfig`); filesystem — workspace project docs/catalog (`project-index.md`, `roadmap.md`, `docs/*.md`), prior sprint `review.md`s (lexicographically earlier slugs only, direct_inputs.go:107), prompt/template overrides, prior artifacts, live target-repository source; stdin none. Outputs: stdout human/JSON results; stderr `[sprint]`/`[runtime]` progress lines (redacted via `config.RedactValue`, app :791); exit codes (0 ok, 2 usage, validation/runtime/workspace/partial/cancel classes); side-effect files listed in §4/§7; agent subprocess runs via the OpenCode adapter. ## 4. Authoritative state - Artifacts under `projects/

/sprints//`: requirements.md, code-context.md, sprint-index.md, technical-handbook.md, `reasoning/*.md`, reasoning.md, plan.md (paths fixed by ArtifactRelPath, artifacts.go:11). - `flow-state.json` / SQLite mirror row (authoritative stage statuses; see §2). - `.stage-sessions.json` (schemaVersion 1; strict decode; temp+chmod0600+rename writes **without fsync**; file removed when empty; session_state.go:62-85, :212). - `.workspace.json` (worktree record: sourceRoot/path/branch/baseline/createdAt). - `.ultra/cache/sprint-context/**` (derived, disposable). - `.runtime-metrics.json` (derived telemetry, cap 512). - `.ultraplan/locks/sprint/

--.lock` (O_EXCL lease file with PID liveness reclaim, verification_lock.go:26-60) plus in-process `sync.Map` lease (service.go:89); lease passed to nested calls via context marker (locks.go:112). - Run-control rows/events (`.ultraplan/run-control.db`) owned by the durable-operation-spine dependency. ## 5. Invariants (as implemented) - Stage order is fixed and cumulative; flow stops at first failing stage; the failing stage is persisted Failed with redacted, newline/NUL-stripped, 180-char-clamped error (`safeError`, flow.go:415). - Dry-run performs no writes and acquires no lease (review/smoke dry-run routes through Verify dry-run instead). - The shared prefix is a pure function of (requirements bytes, code-context bytes, canonical target path); contains exactly one stage boundary; ≤512 KiB; embeds no timestamps/run IDs/output paths; identical across all downstream stages (tests enforce byte equality). - Resolved source evidence is transient per composition and never persisted into code-context.md (fenced content is a validation finding, code_context.go:69). - Every source reference resolves or the whole stage fails closed (validateResolvedCodeContext pre-checks resolvability before promotion). - Code-context artifact replacement is atomic rename with prior-bytes restoration if state persistence fails; runtime failure leaves no artifact. - Requirements/code-context presence alone does not imply Complete in derived state; code-context completion requires persisted flow-state evidence. - Checkpoint compatibility is provider+model+workDir equality; prompt checksum is informational; continuation instructs the agent to reread current state. - Repair is bounded (one product-side continuation; agentwrap spec max 2 attempts with fresh fallback at attempt ≥2). - Catalog steering: sprint-index selections must exist in project-index sections with exact path matches (validation.go:20-48); reasoning outputs must stay inside `projects/

/sprints//reasoning/` with .md extension (reasoning.go:222). - Direct-input packets copy governed inputs verbatim, never truncate, and keep canonical dependency order. - Publication happens after every successful non-execute stage: flow-state.json + stage artifact (+ `.workspace.json` for code-context; all selected reasoning outputs for area-reasoning) via gitpublish; nil publisher = no-op (publication.go:11-55). ## 6. Trust boundaries - User-authored workspace content (catalog, roadmap, docs, prior reviews, prompt/template overrides, evidence reports, reasoning templates) enters prompts verbatim and steers validators; override read failures degrade to embedded "# Prompt Load Error"/"# Missing Prompt Default" text (prompts.go:241-257). - Agent-authored artifacts become prerequisites governing later stages only after structural validation; sprint-index selections decide which files are copied into later prompts (validated against the user catalog). - code-context Path/Lines fields select which live repository bytes enter every downstream prompt; controls enforced: relative clean path, lexical + EvalSymlinks containment, no symlink components, regular file, UTF-8, in-bounds ranges, budget, TOCTOU stability, all failing closed. - Repository bytes are labelled `UNTRUSTED TRANSIENT SOURCE EVIDENCE`; governance text declares them non-executable and non-exclusive. - The implementation root originates from user project-index and is handed to `git worktree add`; worktree identity is re-checked via git-common-dir and branch on reuse. - Runtime/session identifiers (SessionID from adapter events) are persisted and later reused as continuation handles; provider/model/workDir must still match. - Persisted error/detail strings are redacted and clamped before entering flow-state; prompt-context diagnostics suppress absolute root paths. ## 7. External effects & lifecycle semantics Effects: create/replace artifacts; write flow-state.json (+SQLite mirror), .stage-sessions.json, .workspace.json, cache packs, metrics, candidate temps (defer-removed); create/delete git worktree + branch beside the target repo; gitpublish commit/push per configured mode; run-control accept/claim/event/finish rows; spawn OpenCode subprocesses with per-stage sandbox/permissions; runtime-store directories under the sprint path cleaned by 72h/2GiB policy. Cancellation: caller ctx (durable command ctx for CLI flow) propagates into StartRun, per-line source reads, render loops, and the pre-rename check in promotion; canceled/interrupted runs leave the session checkpoint intact for continuation (`LatestOutcome` cancelled/interrupted/cleanup_uncertain recorded, code_context.go:443). `ReconcileInterruptedMutation` (locks.go:25) converts dead-owner residue to explicit interrupted evidence under the same lease, gated by `.cleanup-uncertain.json`. Retry/restart: per-stage skip-if-valid makes rerun idempotent; interrupted sessions resume via checkpoint with automatic fresh restart when the session vanished; failed runtime stores retained 72h; stale lease reclaimed when holder PID is dead; conflicting live lease → `ErrVerificationConflict` → ExitPartial. Error taxonomy: typed prompt-context errors; validation findings (Section/EntryName/Path/Problem/Cause/Suggestion) both rendered and fed to repair prompts; classified CLI exits per §2; state-persistence failures during code-context promotion roll back the artifact. ## 8. Immediate surface dependencies Upstream/consumed: `sprint-flow-state` (flow-state authority + DB mirror semantics), `opencode-agent-runtime` (platform/runtime adapter, RequestFromConfig, ValidationSpec/RepairConfig, runtime stores), `durable-operation-spine` (CLI accept/claim/finish, cancellation ctx), `repo-publication` (gitpublish modes), `product-state-mirror` (productstate Existing/Ensure/Save/Load), `internal/project` (discovery, IsSafeName, ParseProjectIndex, reasoning-default resolution), `internal/workspace` (ResolveInside containment, DefaultOverrideFile). Consumers downstream: execute/review/smoke/QA surfaces (shared prefix, plan/reasoning artifacts), TUI/web via app use cases, `sprint status/metrics`. ## 9. Contracts (CURRENT-CONTRACT evidence) From ultraplan-workspace projects/ultraplan-go/docs: - TRD §7.6 (~L410-450): stage order with code-context after requirements; exactly one authoritative code-context.md, no parallel JSON manifest; target resolution through project index + existing worktree mechanisms; repository reads with stage writes limited to code-context.md in the sprint root; validated-prerequisites gating; required content categories; rejection of unsafe paths/placeholders/malformed ranges; atomic replace on rerun; pre-code-context compatibility; per-stage model/variant config; shared-renderer block order and byte-for-byte stability with no dynamic run data; all downstream agent-backed stages receive the prefix; additional live inspection remains allowed; first implementation must not add RAG/embeddings/repository index/provider cache coupling/auto-staleness detector. - TRD L125: exact requirements + code-context bytes preserved in one shared prefix before stage instructions. - TRD §18 (~L1640-1700): `internal/sprint` owns planning-stage model, artifact path rules, flow-state.json, prompt rendering, validation, flow execution; dependency direction sprint→project/workspace/platform. - TRD §18.8 (~L2008-2028): required commands `sprint

status|validate|prompt|flow --to `; flow options list includes `--from`, `--force`, `--no-skip`, dry-run, model/variant and stage-specific overrides, `--json` for review/smoke/verify/status; `issues` invalid as target. - ARCHITECTURE.md (~L228-263): sprint-owned artifact inventory and ownership bullets including "Stable shared requirements/code-context prompt-prefix rendering". - In-repo: `internal/sprint/doc.go` package contract (runtime-free status, sprint-owned order/state/validation); help texts (sprint_commands.go:1713+) document flow flags and smoke `--yes` requirement. ## 10. Tests (evidence map) - prompt_context_test.go: exact-byte preservation (:14); duplicate/overlap canonicalization (:55); fail-closed resolution per error kind (:78); diagnostics without absolute paths (:114); cancellation/encoding/budget identities (:129); TOCTOU replacement detection (:153); exact 512 KiB boundary acceptance/rejection (:186); no recursion/source mutation (:209); boundary/suffix composition (:242); one exact shared prefix across previews (:258) and runtime requests (:304). - code_context_test.go: content-validation matrix (:51); no-skip without successful outcome (:162,:175); dry-run/execute/rerun preservation (:201); repair within runtime boundary (:246); event-output fallback (:277); resolved repository untouched (:289); mutation-conflict boundary (:325); pre-code-context compat + serialization (:382); runtime failure leaves no artifact (:422); missing output/unsupported permissions/cancellation fail closed (:440); persistence failure restores prior artifact (:496). - session_state_test.go: continuation from checkpoint (:50); completed stages delete session+checkpoint (:81); prompt-change tolerance (:103); dimension-scoped keys (:121); fresh restart on missing session (:147); interrupted-execute session retention (:172). - handbook_test.go (:14,:46,:85), reasoning_test.go (:14,:73,:118,:135,:174), plan_test.go (:13,:68,:101,:113), sprint_index_test.go (parse vs catalog :15, runtime-free previews :36, state updates :73, runtime validation wiring :97, skeleton rules :113/:138/:161, code-context scheduled once in cumulative flow :175), sprint_test.go (domain :17, safeError redaction :43, derivation :50, strict state load + atomic write :100, legacy classification :152, status refresh :179), direct_inputs_test.go (order/explanation :10, full-copy of oversized inputs :32, path redaction :50, prior-review ordering :62). Baseline: full `go test ./...` green at frozen commit (review/baseline/go-test.txt, -race variant present). ## 11. Explicit unknowns / open questions (for later reviewers) 1. `.stage-sessions.json` format and checkpoint semantics have no external contract; TRD/ARCHITECTURE never mention stage-session checkpoints — implementation-defined only (including rename-without-fsync durability). 2. TRD §18.8 lists flow options `--from`, `--force`, `--no-skip`; `parseSprintFlowArgs` (sprint_commands.go:1003) implements none of them. Deferral intent is not recorded in-repo. 3. Cache packs live under `/.ultra/cache/...` while operational state uses `.ultraplan/...`; no documentation found explaining the `.ultra` vs `.ultraplan` split (normalizeWorkspacePath strips prototype-era `.ultra/` prefixes, handbook.go:133). 4. `planningSessionNotFound` detects lost sessions by substring "session not found" across free-form adapter output; the adapter-side error taxonomy contract was not verified in this pack (opencode-agent-runtime surface). 5. `stageSessionCompatible` ignores variant changes (provider+model+workDir only); continuation across variant switches is accepted by design comment (session_state.go:87-92); interaction with per-stage model overrides is otherwise undocumented. 6. Context-pack pruning keeps the 8 newest by mtime; behavior under clock skew or concurrent same-key writers is unspecified. 7. Concurrent flows over different sprints sharing one target repository: worktree parent dirs are shared; collision behavior is an error (execute_target.go:159); supported concurrency level undocumented. 8. `FlowStage` skips the already-valid/publish/clear-checkpoint loop that `Flow` applies per stage; intended equivalence for single-stage durable operations is not documented. 9. PID liveness via `syscall.Kill` (verification_lock.go:95) is POSIX-only; Windows behavior of lease reclaim is not addressed in files reviewed. 10. Area-reasoning entries run strictly sequentially; no documented rationale or ceiling for large template selections (budget impact lands on the 512 KiB prefix only via shared evidence, while direct-input copies are uncapped by design — direct_inputs.go:184-186 states the provider owns context limits).

230: func canonicalSharedSelections(refs []sharedContextReference) ([]sharedSourceSelection, error) {
231: 	positions := map[string]int{}
232: 	selections := make([]sharedSourceSelection, 0, len(refs))
233: 	for _, ref := range refs {
234: 		ranges, err := parseSharedLineRanges(ref.Path, ref.Lines)
235: 		if err != nil {
236: 			return nil, err
237: 		}
238: 		position, ok := positions[ref.Path]
239: 		if !ok {
240: 			position = len(selections)
241: 			positions[ref.Path] = position
242: 			selections = append(selections, sharedSourceSelection{Path: ref.Path})
243: 		}
244: 		selections[position].Ranges = append(selections[position].Ranges, ranges...)
245: 		selections[position].References = append(selections[position].References, ref)
246: 	}
247: 	for i := range selections {
248: 		ranges := selections[i].Ranges
249: 		sort.Slice(ranges, func(a, b int) bool {
250: 			if ranges[a].Start != ranges[b].Start {
251: 				return ranges[a].Start < ranges[b].Start
252: 			}
253: 			return ranges[a].End < ranges[b].End
254: 		})
255: 		merged := make([]sharedLineRange, 0, len(ranges))
256: 		for _, current := range ranges {
257: 			if len(merged) == 0 || current.Start > merged[len(merged)-1].End+1 {
258: 				merged = append(merged, current)
259: 				continue
260: 			}
261: 			if current.End > merged[len(merged)-1].End {
262: 				merged[len(merged)-1].End = current.End
263: 			}
264: 		}
265: 		selections[i].Ranges = merged
266: 		selections[i].Lines = formatSharedLineRanges(merged)
267: 	}
268: 	return selections, nil
269: }

271: func formatSharedLineRanges(ranges []sharedLineRange) string {

276: 		} else {
277: 			parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("%d-%d", selected.Start, selected.End))
278: 		}
279: 	}

283: func parseSharedContextReferences(content string) ([]sharedContextReference, error) {

292: 		}
293: 		ref := sharedContextReference{
294: 			Name:      strings.TrimSpace(entry.name),
295: 			Path:      strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(path[1]), "`"),
296: 			Lines:     strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(lines[1]), "`"),
297: 			Rationale: strings.TrimSpace(reason[1]),
298: 		}
299: 		if symbol := codeContextSymbolRE.FindStringSubmatch(entry.body); len(symbol) == 2 {
300: 			ref.Symbol = strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(symbol[1]), "`")

307: func parseSharedLineRanges(path, value string) ([]sharedLineRange, error) {
308: 	var ranges []sharedLineRange
309: 	for _, segment := range strings.Split(value, ",") {
310: 		segment = strings.TrimSpace(segment)
311: 		parts := strings.Split(segment, "-")
312: 		start, err := strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimSpace(parts[0]))
313: 		if err != nil || start < 1 || len(parts) > 2 {
314: 			return nil, &promptContextError{Kind: promptContextInvalidRange, Path: path, LineRange: value, Err: errors.New("range must be a positive N or N-M")}
315: 		}
316: 		end := start
317: 		if len(parts) == 2 {
318: 			end, err = strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimSpace(parts[1]))
319: 			if err != nil || end < start {
320: 				return nil, &promptContextError{Kind: promptContextInvalidRange, Path: path, LineRange: value, Err: errors.New("range end precedes its start")}
321: 			}
322: 		}
323: 		ranges = append(ranges, sharedLineRange{Start: start, End: end})
324: 	}
325: 	return ranges, nil
326: }

346: func readSharedSource(ctx context.Context, root, rel, lineRange string, ranges []sharedLineRange, budget int) (string, error) {
347: 	if err := validateRepositoryRelativePath(rel); err != nil {
348: 		return "", &promptContextError{Kind: promptContextInvalidPath, Path: rel, LineRange: lineRange, Err: err}
349: 	}
350: 	candidate := filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(rel))
351: 	if !inside(root, candidate) {
352: 		return "", &promptContextError{Kind: promptContextContainment, Path: rel, LineRange: lineRange, Err: errors.New("path escapes implementation root")}
353: 	}
354: 	current := root
355: 	for _, component := range strings.Split(filepath.ToSlash(rel), "/") {
356: 		current = filepath.Join(current, filepath.FromSlash(component))
357: 		info, err := os.Lstat(current)
358: 		if err != nil {
359: 			kind := promptContextMissing
360: 			if !os.IsNotExist(err) {
361: 				kind = promptContextContainment
362: 			}
363: 			return "", &promptContextError{Kind: kind, Path: rel, LineRange: lineRange, Err: err}
364: 		}
365: 		if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
366: 			return "", &promptContextError{Kind: promptContextContainment, Path: rel, LineRange: lineRange, Err: errors.New("symlink components are not allowed")}
367: 		}
368: 	}
369: 	canonical, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(candidate)
370: 	if err != nil || !inside(root, canonical) {
371: 		if err == nil {
372: 			err = errors.New("canonical path escapes implementation root")
373: 		}
374: 		return "", &promptContextError{Kind: promptContextContainment, Path: rel, LineRange: lineRange, Err: err}
375: 	}
376: 	before, err := os.Stat(candidate)
377: 	if err != nil {
378: 		return "", &promptContextError{Kind: promptContextMissing, Path: rel, LineRange: lineRange, Err: err}
379: 	}
380: 	if !before.Mode().IsRegular() {
381: 		return "", &promptContextError{Kind: promptContextFileKind, Path: rel, LineRange: lineRange, Err: errors.New("selected source is not a regular file")}
382: 	}
383: 	f, err := os.Open(candidate)
384: 	if err != nil {
385: 		return "", &promptContextError{Kind: promptContextMissing, Path: rel, LineRange: lineRange, Err: err}
386: 	}
387: 	defer f.Close()
388: 	handleBefore, err := f.Stat()
389: 	if err != nil || !handleBefore.Mode().IsRegular() || !os.SameFile(before, handleBefore) {
390: 		if err == nil {
391: 			err = errors.New("opened source identity does not match the selected path")
392: 		}
393: 		return "", &promptContextError{Kind: promptContextChanged, Path: rel, LineRange: lineRange, Err: err}
394: 	}
395: 
396: 	data, totalLines, err := readSharedLineRanges(ctx, f, ranges, budget)
397: 	if err != nil {
398: 		if errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) || errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
399: 			return "", err
400: 		}
401: 		return "", &promptContextError{Kind: promptContextBudget, Path: rel, LineRange: lineRange, Allowed: budget, Observed: budget + 1, Err: err}
402: 	}
403: 	for _, selected := range ranges {
404: 		if selected.End > totalLines {
405: 			return "", &promptContextError{Kind: promptContextInvalidRange, Path: rel, LineRange: lineRange, Err: fmt.Errorf("range ends at line %d but file has %d lines", selected.End, totalLines)}
406: 		}
407: 	}
408: 	source := string(data)
409: 	if !utf8.ValidString(source) {
410: 		return "", &promptContextError{Kind: promptContextEncoding, Path: rel, LineRange: lineRange, Err: errors.New("selected source is not valid UTF-8")}
411: 	}
412: 	handleAfter, err := f.Stat()
413: 	if err != nil {
414: 		return "", &promptContextError{Kind: promptContextChanged, Path: rel, LineRange: lineRange, Err: err}
415: 	}
416: 	if err := verifySharedSourceUnchanged(root, candidate, canonical, rel, lineRange, handleBefore, handleAfter); err != nil {
417: 		return "", err
418: 	}
419: 	return source, nil
420: }

422: func verifySharedSourceUnchanged(root, candidate, canonical, rel, lineRange string, handleBefore, handleAfter os.FileInfo) error {
423: 	after, err := os.Stat(candidate)
424: 	if err != nil || !os.SameFile(handleBefore, handleAfter) || !os.SameFile(handleBefore, after) || handleBefore.Size() != handleAfter.Size() || !handleBefore.ModTime().Equal(handleAfter.ModTime()) {
425: 		if err == nil {
426: 			err = errors.New("selected source changed while it was read")
427: 		}
428: 		return &promptContextError{Kind: promptContextChanged, Path: rel, LineRange: lineRange, Err: err}
429: 	}
430: 	canonicalAfter, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(candidate)
431: 	if err != nil || canonicalAfter != canonical || !inside(root, canonicalAfter) {
432: 		if err == nil {
433: 			err = errors.New("selected source canonical location changed while it was read")
434: 		}
435: 		return &promptContextError{Kind: promptContextChanged, Path: rel, LineRange: lineRange, Err: err}
436: 	}
437: 	return nil
438: }

444: func readSharedLineRanges(ctx context.Context, r io.Reader, selected []sharedLineRange, budget int) ([]byte, int, error) {
445: 	reader := bufio.NewReaderSize(r, sharedSourceReadBuffer)
446: 	line := 1
447: 	total := 0
448: 	var out []byte
449: 	rangeIndex := 0
450: 	for {
451: 		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
452: 			return nil, 0, err
453: 		}
454: 		fragment, err := reader.ReadSlice('\n')
455: 		if len(fragment) > 0 {
456: 			total = line
457: 			for rangeIndex < len(selected) && line > selected[rangeIndex].End {
458: 				rangeIndex++
459: 			}
460: 			included := rangeIndex < len(selected) && line >= selected[rangeIndex].Start && line <= selected[rangeIndex].End
461: 			if included {
462: 				if len(fragment) > budget-len(out) {
463: 					return nil, 0, errors.New("selected source exceeds remaining shared prompt budget")
464: 				}
465: 				out = append(out, fragment...)
466: 			}
467: 			if fragment[len(fragment)-1] == '\n' {
468: 				line++
469: 			}
470: 		}
471: 		switch err {
472: 		case nil:
473: 			continue
474: 		case bufio.ErrBufferFull:
475: 			continue
476: 		case io.EOF:
477: 			return out, total, nil
478: 		default:
479: 			return nil, 0, err
480: 		}
481: 	}
482: }

486: 		return nil
487: 	}

230: func canonicalSharedSelections(refs []sharedContextReference) ([]sharedSourceSelection, error) {

238: 		position, ok := positions[ref.Path]

241: 			positions[ref.Path] = position
242: 			selections = append(selections, sharedSourceSelection{Path: ref.Path})
243: 		}
244: 		selections[position].Ranges = append(selections[position].Ranges, ranges...)
245: 		selections[position].References = append(selections[position].References, ref)
246: 	}
247: 	for i := range selections {
248: 		ranges := selections[i].Ranges
249: 		sort.Slice(ranges, func(a, b int) bool {
250: 			if ranges[a].Start != ranges[b].Start {
251: 				return ranges[a].Start < ranges[b].Start
252: 			}
253: 			return ranges[a].End < ranges[b].End
254: 		})
255: 		merged := make([]sharedLineRange, 0, len(ranges))
256: 		for _, current := range ranges {
257: 			if len(merged) == 0 || current.Start > merged[len(merged)-1].End+1 {
258: 				merged = append(merged, current)

261: 			if current.End > merged[len(merged)-1].End {

266: 		selections[i].Lines = formatSharedLineRanges(merged)

379: 	}
380: 	if !before.Mode().IsRegular() {

192: // withStageOverrides returns a service copy whose stage runtime map is merged
193: // with request-scoped stage model/variant overrides. Configured defaults stay
194: // unchanged for stages without an entry.
195: func (s Service) withStageOverrides(overrides map[PlanningStage]StageRuntime) Service {
196: 	if len(overrides) == 0 {
197: 		return s
198: 	}
199: 	merged := make(map[PlanningStage]StageRuntime, len(s.stageRuntime)+len(overrides))
200: 	for stage, override := range s.stageRuntime {
201: 		merged[stage] = override
202: 	}
203: 	for stage, override := range overrides {
204: 		if override.Model == "" && override.Variant == "" {
205: 			continue
206: 		}
207: 		current := merged[stage]
208: 		if override.Model != "" {
209: 			current.Model = override.Model
210: 		}
211: 		if override.Variant != "" {
212: 			current.Variant = override.Variant
213: 		}
214: 		merged[stage] = current
215: 	}
216: 	s.stageRuntime = merged
217: 	return s
218: }

229: func (s Service) Status(projectRef, sprintRef string) (StatusSummary, error) {
230: 	projects, err := project.DiscoverProjects(s.root)
231: 	if err != nil {
232: 		return StatusSummary{}, err
233: 	}
234: 	p, err := project.ResolveProject(projects, projectRef)
235: 	if err != nil {
236: 		return StatusSummary{}, err
237: 	}
238: 	sprints, err := DiscoverSprints(s.root, p)
239: 	if err != nil {
240: 		return StatusSummary{}, err
241: 	}
242: 	sp, err := ResolveSprint(sprints, sprintRef)
243: 	if err != nil {
244: 		return StatusSummary{}, err
245: 	}
246: 	if !inside(p.Path, sp.Path) {
247: 		return StatusSummary{}, fmt.Errorf("sprint path mismatch for %q", sp.Slug)
248: 	}
249: 	legacyCodeContextState := preCodeContextFlowState(s.root, sp)
250: 	state, err := LoadFlowState(s.root, sp)
251: 	stateLoaded := err == nil
252: 	if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, ErrFlowStateMissing) {
253: 		return StatusSummary{}, err
254: 	}
255: 	snap, err := s.store.ReadArtifacts(sp)
256: 	if err != nil {
257: 		return StatusSummary{}, err
258: 	}
259: 	var prior []StageState
260: 	if stateLoaded {
261: 		prior = state.Stages
262: 	}
263: 	stages := DeriveStages(sp, snap, prior)
264: 	refreshed := NewFlowState(sp, stages, s.now())
265: 	if stateLoaded {
266: 		refreshed.Review = state.Review
267: 		refreshed.Smoke = state.Smoke
268: 		refreshed.QA = state.QA
269: 		if refreshed.Review != nil && refreshed.Review.Fingerprint != "" {
270: 			manifest, reviewFindings, reviewErr := s.PrepareReview(projectRef, sprintRef, ReviewRequest{})
271: 			refreshed.Review.Stale = reviewErr != nil || len(reviewFindings) > 0 || (strictCompletedReviewSnapshotFreshness && manifest.Fingerprint != refreshed.Review.Fingerprint)
272: 			if !refreshed.Review.Stale {
273: 				content, readErr := s.store.ReadArtifact(sp, StageReview)
274: 				validationManifest := manifest
275: 				if !strictCompletedReviewSnapshotFreshness {
276: 					validationManifest.Fingerprint = refreshed.Review.Fingerprint
277: 				}
278: 				refreshed.Review.Stale = readErr != nil || len(ValidateReviewContent(content, validationManifest)) > 0 || refreshed.Review.ArtifactDigest == "" || hashBytes([]byte(content)) != refreshed.Review.ArtifactDigest
279: 			}
280: 		}
281: 		if refreshed.Smoke != nil {
282: 			smokePath, pathErr := ArtifactPath(s.root, sp, StageSmoke)
283: 			data, readErr := os.ReadFile(smokePath)
284: 			invalid := pathErr != nil || readErr != nil || len(ValidateSmokeContent(string(data))) > 0
285: 			fingerprintMismatch := readErr == nil && refreshed.Smoke.SmokeFingerprint != "" && refreshed.Smoke.SmokeFingerprint != hashBytes(data)
286: 			reviewMismatch := refreshed.Review == nil || refreshed.Review.Stale || refreshed.Smoke.ReviewFingerprint != refreshed.Review.Fingerprint
287: 			refreshed.Smoke.Stale = invalid || fingerprintMismatch || reviewMismatch
288: 			refreshed.Smoke.Reconciliation = fingerprintMismatch || (readErr == nil && refreshed.Smoke.SmokeFingerprint == "")
289: 		}
290: 	}
291: 	if s.statusWrites && !legacyCodeContextState {
292: 		if err := SaveFlowState(s.root, sp, refreshed); err != nil {
293: 			return StatusSummary{}, err
294: 		}
295: 	}
296: 	flowPath, err := FlowStatePath(s.root, sp)
297: 	if err != nil {
298: 		return StatusSummary{}, err
299: 	}
300: 	var executeState *ExecuteRunState
301: 	var historicalExecutionStatus string
302: 	loadedExecute, executeErr := LoadExecuteRunState(s.root, sp)
303: 	if executeErr != nil && !errors.Is(executeErr, ErrExecuteRunStateMissing) {
304: 		if legacyStatus, ok := LegacyTerminalExecuteStatus(s.root, sp); ok {
305: 			historicalExecutionStatus = legacyStatus
306: 		} else {
307: 			return StatusSummary{}, executeErr
308: 		}
309: 	}
310: 	if executeErr == nil {
311: 		executeState = &loadedExecute
312: 	}
313: 	runStatePath, err := ExecuteRunStatePath(s.root, sp)
314: 	if err != nil {
315: 		return StatusSummary{}, err
316: 	}
317: 	verification := VerificationStatus{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug}
318: 	if historicalExecutionStatus == "" {
319: 		var verificationErr error
320: 		verification, verificationErr = s.VerificationStatus(projectRef, sprintRef)
321: 		if verificationErr != nil && !errors.Is(verificationErr, ErrFlowStateMissing) {
322: 			return StatusSummary{}, verificationErr
323: 		}
324: 	} else {
325: 		verification.Assessment = AssessmentNotApplicable
326: 		verification.NextAction = "Historical terminal execution evidence is preserved; modern review and smoke evidence is not available."
327: 	}
328: 	return StatusSummary{
329: 		Project:                   sp.Project,
330: 		Sprint:                    sp.Slug,
331: 		SprintRoot:                workspace.Rel(s.root, sp.Path),
332: 		FlowStatePath:             workspace.Rel(s.root, flowPath),
333: 		Stages:                    stages,
334: 		ExecuteState:              executeState,
335: 		HistoricalExecutionStatus: historicalExecutionStatus,
336: 		ExecutePath:               ArtifactRelPath(sp, StageExecute),
337: 		RunStatePath:              workspace.Rel(s.root, runStatePath),
338: 		Review:                    refreshed.Review,
339: 		ReviewPath:                ArtifactRelPath(sp, StageReview),
340: 		Smoke:                     refreshed.Smoke,
341: 		SmokePath:                 ArtifactRelPath(sp, StageSmoke),
342: 		QA:                        refreshed.QA,
343: 		Verification:              verification,
344: 	}, nil
345: }

583: func (s Service) FlowRequirements(ctx context.Context, projectRef, sprintRef string, req FlowRequest) (FlowResult, error) {
584: 	if err := validateFlowTarget(req.To); err != nil {
585: 		return FlowResult{}, err
586: 	}
587: 	sp, catalog, docs, err := s.resolveSprintForRequirements(projectRef, sprintRef, !req.DryRun)
588: 	if err != nil {
589: 		return FlowResult{}, err
590: 	}
591: 	now := s.now().UTC()
592: 	prompt := RenderRequirementsPrompt(s.root, sp, catalog, docs)
593: 	if req.DryRun {
594: 		return FlowResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, To: req.To, DryRun: true, Message: prompt.Prompt}, nil
595: 	}
596: 	if s.runtime == nil {
597: 		err := fmt.Errorf("runtime is required for requirements flow")
598: 		stages := flowFailedStages(sp, req.To, err, now)
599: 		_ = SaveFlowState(s.root, sp, NewFlowState(sp, stages, now))
600: 		return FlowResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, To: req.To, Stages: stages}, err
601: 	}
602: 	runtimeReq := s.runtimeRequest(prompt.Prompt, map[string]string{"project": sp.Project, "sprint": sp.Slug, "stage": string(StageRequirements)})
603: 	runtimeReq.Validation = s.requirementsValidationSpec(sp)
604: 	runtimeResult, err := s.startPlanningStageRun(ctx, sp, StageRequirements, runtimeReq)
605: 	if err != nil {
606: 		stages := flowFailedStages(sp, req.To, err, now)
607: 		_ = SaveFlowState(s.root, sp, NewFlowState(sp, stages, now))
608: 		return FlowResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, To: req.To, Runtime: runtimeResult, Stages: stages}, err
609: 	}
610: 	content, err := s.store.ReadArtifact(sp, StageRequirements)
611: 	if err != nil {
612: 		stages := flowFailedStages(sp, req.To, err, now)
613: 		_ = SaveFlowState(s.root, sp, NewFlowState(sp, stages, now))
614: 		return FlowResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, To: req.To, Runtime: runtimeResult, Stages: stages}, err
615: 	}
616: 	findings := ValidateRequirementsContent(content)
617: 	if len(findings) > 0 {
618: 		runtimeResult, findings, err = s.repairGeneratedArtifact(ctx, runtimeReq, runtimeResult, ArtifactRelPath(sp, StageRequirements), findings, func() []ValidationFinding {
619: 			data, readErr := s.store.ReadArtifact(sp, StageRequirements)
620: 			if readErr != nil {
621: 				return []ValidationFinding{finding("requirements.md", "", ArtifactRelPath(sp, StageRequirements), "missing requirements", readErr.Error(), "Generate requirements.md.")}
622: 			}
623: 			return ValidateRequirementsContent(data)
624: 		})
625: 		if err != nil {
626: 			stages := flowFailedStages(sp, req.To, err, now)
627: 			_ = SaveFlowState(s.root, sp, NewFlowState(sp, stages, now))
628: 			return FlowResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, To: req.To, Runtime: runtimeResult, Stages: stages}, err
629: 		}
630: 	}
631: 	if len(findings) > 0 {
632: 		err := fmt.Errorf("generated requirements.md failed validation")
633: 		stages := flowFailedStages(sp, req.To, err, now)
634: 		_ = SaveFlowState(s.root, sp, NewFlowState(sp, stages, now))
635: 		return FlowResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, To: req.To, Runtime: runtimeResult, Stages: stages, Findings: findings}, err
636: 	}
637: 	stages := flowRequirementsSuccessStages(sp, now)
638: 	if err := SaveFlowState(s.root, sp, NewFlowState(sp, stages, now)); err != nil {
639: 		return FlowResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, To: req.To, Runtime: runtimeResult, Stages: stages}, err
640: 	}
641: 	_ = s.cleanupPlanningStageSessions(ctx, sp, StageRequirements, runtimeResult)
642: 	return FlowResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, To: req.To, Runtime: runtimeResult, Stages: stages, Message: "requirements complete"}, nil
643: }

910: 	}
911: 	sp, inputs, catalog, err := s.resolveSprintInputsForFlow(projectRef, sprintRef, !req.DryRun)
912: 	if err != nil {

914: 	}

921: 	}

956: func (s Service) resolveSprintInputsWithCreate(projectRef, sprintRef string, createMissing bool) (Sprint, PlanningInputs, project.ProjectIndex, error) {
957: 	projects, err := project.DiscoverProjects(s.root)
958: 	if err != nil {
959: 		return Sprint{}, PlanningInputs{}, project.ProjectIndex{}, err
960: 	}
961: 	p, err := project.ResolveProject(projects, projectRef)
962: 	if err != nil {
963: 		return Sprint{}, PlanningInputs{}, project.ProjectIndex{}, err
964: 	}
965: 	sprints, err := DiscoverSprints(s.root, p)
966: 	if err != nil {
967: 		return Sprint{}, PlanningInputs{}, project.ProjectIndex{}, err
968: 	}
969: 	sp, err := ResolveSprint(sprints, sprintRef)
970: 	if err != nil {
971: 		var refErr RefError
972: 		if !createMissing || !errors.As(err, &refErr) || refErr.Ambiguous {
973: 			return Sprint{}, PlanningInputs{}, project.ProjectIndex{}, err
974: 		}
975: 		sp, err = s.createSprintSkeleton(p, sprintRef)
976: 		if err != nil {
977: 			return Sprint{}, PlanningInputs{}, project.ProjectIndex{}, err
978: 		}
979: 	}
980: 	if !inside(p.Path, sp.Path) {
981: 		return Sprint{}, PlanningInputs{}, project.ProjectIndex{}, fmt.Errorf("sprint path mismatch for %q", sp.Slug)
982: 	}
983: 	inputs, err := s.store.ReadPlanningInputs(sp)
984: 	if err != nil {
985: 		return Sprint{}, PlanningInputs{}, project.ProjectIndex{}, err
986: 	}
987: 	catalog, parseFindings := project.ParseProjectIndex(inputs.ProjectIndex)
988: 	if len(parseFindings) > 0 {
989: 		return Sprint{}, PlanningInputs{}, project.ProjectIndex{}, fmt.Errorf("project-index.md has malformed catalog rows")
990: 	}
991: 	return sp, inputs, catalog, nil
992: }

583: func (s Service) FlowRequirements(ctx context.Context, projectRef, sprintRef string, req FlowRequest) (FlowResult, error) {
584: 	if err := validateFlowTarget(req.To); err != nil {
585: 		return FlowResult{}, err
586: 	}
587: 	sp, catalog, docs, err := s.resolveSprintForRequirements(projectRef, sprintRef, !req.DryRun)
588: 	if err != nil {
589: 		return FlowResult{}, err
590: 	}
591: 	now := s.now().UTC()
592: 	prompt := RenderRequirementsPrompt(s.root, sp, catalog, docs)
593: 	if req.DryRun {
594: 		return FlowResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, To: req.To, DryRun: true, Message: prompt.Prompt}, nil
595: 	}
596: 	if s.runtime == nil {
597: 		err := fmt.Errorf("runtime is required for requirements flow")
598: 		stages := flowFailedStages(sp, req.To, err, now)
599: 		_ = SaveFlowState(s.root, sp, NewFlowState(sp, stages, now))
600: 		return FlowResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, To: req.To, Stages: stages}, err
601: 	}
602: 	runtimeReq := s.runtimeRequest(prompt.Prompt, map[string]string{"project": sp.Project, "sprint": sp.Slug, "stage": string(StageRequirements)})
603: 	runtimeReq.Validation = s.requirementsValidationSpec(sp)
604: 	runtimeResult, err := s.startPlanningStageRun(ctx, sp, StageRequirements, runtimeReq)
605: 	if err != nil {
606: 		stages := flowFailedStages(sp, req.To, err, now)
607: 		_ = SaveFlowState(s.root, sp, NewFlowState(sp, stages, now))
608: 		return FlowResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, To: req.To, Runtime: runtimeResult, Stages: stages}, err
609: 	}
610: 	content, err := s.store.ReadArtifact(sp, StageRequirements)
611: 	if err != nil {
612: 		stages := flowFailedStages(sp, req.To, err, now)
613: 		_ = SaveFlowState(s.root, sp, NewFlowState(sp, stages, now))
614: 		return FlowResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, To: req.To, Runtime: runtimeResult, Stages: stages}, err
615: 	}
616: 	findings := ValidateRequirementsContent(content)
617: 	if len(findings) > 0 {
618: 		runtimeResult, findings, err = s.repairGeneratedArtifact(ctx, runtimeReq, runtimeResult, ArtifactRelPath(sp, StageRequirements), findings, func() []ValidationFinding {
619: 			data, readErr := s.store.ReadArtifact(sp, StageRequirements)
620: 			if readErr != nil {
621: 				return []ValidationFinding{finding("requirements.md", "", ArtifactRelPath(sp, StageRequirements), "missing requirements", readErr.Error(), "Generate requirements.md.")}
622: 			}
623: 			return ValidateRequirementsContent(data)
624: 		})
625: 		if err != nil {
626: 			stages := flowFailedStages(sp, req.To, err, now)
627: 			_ = SaveFlowState(s.root, sp, NewFlowState(sp, stages, now))
628: 			return FlowResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, To: req.To, Runtime: runtimeResult, Stages: stages}, err
629: 		}
630: 	}
631: 	if len(findings) > 0 {
632: 		err := fmt.Errorf("generated requirements.md failed validation")
633: 		stages := flowFailedStages(sp, req.To, err, now)
634: 		_ = SaveFlowState(s.root, sp, NewFlowState(sp, stages, now))
635: 		return FlowResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, To: req.To, Runtime: runtimeResult, Stages: stages, Findings: findings}, err
636: 	}
637: 	stages := flowRequirementsSuccessStages(sp, now)
638: 	if err := SaveFlowState(s.root, sp, NewFlowState(sp, stages, now)); err != nil {
639: 		return FlowResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, To: req.To, Runtime: runtimeResult, Stages: stages}, err
640: 	}
641: 	_ = s.cleanupPlanningStageSessions(ctx, sp, StageRequirements, runtimeResult)
642: 	return FlowResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, To: req.To, Runtime: runtimeResult, Stages: stages, Message: "requirements complete"}, nil
643: }

648: 	}
649: 	sp, inputs, catalog, err := s.resolveSprintInputsForFlow(projectRef, sprintRef, !req.DryRun)
650: 	if err != nil {
651: 		return FlowResult{}, err
652: 	}
653: 	now := s.now().UTC()
654: 	if findings, prerequisiteErr := s.codeContextPrerequisite(sp); prerequisiteErr != nil {
655: 		stages := s.flowFailedStages(sp, req.To, prerequisiteErr, now)
656: 		if !req.DryRun {
657: 			_ = SaveFlowState(s.root, sp, NewFlowState(sp, stages, now))
658: 		}
659: 		return FlowResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, To: req.To, DryRun: req.DryRun, Stages: stages, Findings: findings}, prerequisiteErr
660: 	}
661: 	if stringsTrim(inputs.Requirements) == "" || containsPlaceholder(inputs.Requirements) {
662: 		err := fmt.Errorf("requirements.md is empty or contains placeholder content")
663: 		stages := flowFailedStages(sp, req.To, err, now)
664: 		if !req.DryRun {
665: 			_ = SaveFlowState(s.root, sp, NewFlowState(sp, stages, now))
666: 		}
667: 		return FlowResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, To: req.To, DryRun: req.DryRun, Stages: stages}, err
668: 	}
669: 	prompt, promptErr := s.composeSharedRuntimePrompt(ctx, sp, inputs, RenderSprintIndexPrompt(s.root, sp, catalog, inputs.Docs))
670: 	if promptErr != nil {
671: 		stages := s.flowFailedStages(sp, req.To, promptErr, now)
672: 		if !req.DryRun {
673: 			_ = SaveFlowState(s.root, sp, NewFlowState(sp, stages, now))
674: 		}
675: 		return FlowResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, To: req.To, DryRun: req.DryRun, Stages: stages}, promptErr
676: 	}
677: 	if req.DryRun {
678: 		return FlowResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, To: req.To, DryRun: true, Message: prompt.Prompt}, nil
679: 	}
680: 	if s.runtime == nil {
681: 		err := fmt.Errorf("runtime is required for sprint-index flow")
682: 		stages := flowFailedStages(sp, req.To, err, now)
683: 		_ = SaveFlowState(s.root, sp, NewFlowState(sp, stages, now))
684: 		return FlowResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, To: req.To, Stages: stages}, err
685: 	}
686: 	runtimeReq := s.runtimeRequest(prompt.Prompt, map[string]string{"project": sp.Project, "sprint": sp.Slug, "stage": string(StageSprintIndex)})
687: 	runtimeReq.Validation = s.sprintIndexValidationSpec(sp, catalog)
688: 	runtimeResult, err := s.startPlanningStageRun(ctx, sp, StageSprintIndex, runtimeReq)
689: 	if err != nil {
690: 		stages := flowFailedStages(sp, req.To, err, now)
691: 		_ = SaveFlowState(s.root, sp, NewFlowState(sp, stages, now))
692: 		return FlowResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, To: req.To, Runtime: runtimeResult, Stages: stages}, err
693: 	}
694: 	inputs, err = s.store.ReadPlanningInputs(sp)
695: 	if err != nil {
696: 		stages := flowFailedStages(sp, req.To, err, now)
697: 		_ = SaveFlowState(s.root, sp, NewFlowState(sp, stages, now))
698: 		return FlowResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, To: req.To, Runtime: runtimeResult, Stages: stages}, err
699: 	}
700: 	index, findings := ValidateSprintIndexContent(inputs.SprintIndex, catalog)
701: 	if len(findings) > 0 {
702: 		runtimeResult, findings, err = s.repairGeneratedArtifact(ctx, runtimeReq, runtimeResult, ArtifactRelPath(sp, StageSprintIndex), findings, func() []ValidationFinding {
703: 			updated, readErr := s.store.ReadPlanningInputs(sp)
704: 			if readErr != nil {
705: 				return []ValidationFinding{finding("sprint-index.md", "", ArtifactRelPath(sp, StageSprintIndex), "missing sprint index", readErr.Error(), "Generate sprint-index.md.")}
706: 			}
707: 			var updatedIndex SprintIndex
708: 			updatedIndex, findings = ValidateSprintIndexContent(updated.SprintIndex, catalog)
709: 			index = updatedIndex
710: 			return findings
711: 		})
712: 		if err != nil {
713: 			stages := flowFailedStages(sp, req.To, err, now)
714: 			_ = SaveFlowState(s.root, sp, NewFlowState(sp, stages, now))
715: 			return FlowResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, To: req.To, Runtime: runtimeResult, Stages: stages}, err
716: 		}
717: 	}
718: 	if len(findings) > 0 {
719: 		err := fmt.Errorf("generated sprint-index.md failed validation")
720: 		stages := flowFailedStages(sp, req.To, err, now)
721: 		_ = SaveFlowState(s.root, sp, NewFlowState(sp, stages, now))
722: 		return FlowResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, To: req.To, Runtime: runtimeResult, Stages: stages, Findings: findings}, err
723: 	}
724: 	stages := flowSprintIndexSuccessStages(sp, index.NoTemplates, now)
725: 	if err := SaveFlowState(s.root, sp, NewFlowState(sp, stages, now)); err != nil {
726: 		return FlowResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, To: req.To, Runtime: runtimeResult, Stages: stages}, err

728: 	_ = s.cleanupPlanningStageSessions(ctx, sp, StageSprintIndex, runtimeResult)
729: 	return FlowResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, To: req.To, Runtime: runtimeResult, Stages: stages, Message: "sprint-index complete"}, nil

1500: 			if snap.Files[stage] {
1501: 				if priorState, ok := previous[stage]; !ok || priorState.Status != StatusFailed {
1502: 					status = StatusComplete

1505: 		case StageCodeContext:

50: 	firstLine := trimmed
51: 	if newline := strings.IndexByte(firstLine, '\n'); newline >= 0 {
52: 		firstLine = firstLine[:newline]
53: 	}
54: 	if strings.TrimSpace(firstLine) != "# Sprint Code Context" {
55: 		findings = append(findings, finding(
56: 			"code-context.md",
57: 			"",
58: 			"",
59: 			"invalid document start",
60: 			"the first non-whitespace line is not the canonical level-one title",
61: 			"Return only the Markdown document beginning with # Sprint Code Context; remove preambles and outer fences.",
62: 		))
63: 	}
64: 	if containsPlaceholder(trimmed) || containsCodeContextPlaceholder(trimmed) {
65: 		findings = append(findings, finding("code-context.md", "", "", "placeholder content", "the artifact still contains template placeholders", "Replace every placeholder with inspected repository evidence."))
66: 		sortSprintFindings(findings)
67: 		return findings
68: 	}
69: 	if codeContextFenceRE.MatchString(trimmed) {
70: 		findings = append(findings, finding("code-context.md", "", "", "embedded source content", "the durable context artifact must contain references rather than copied fenced content", "Remove fenced content and keep source locations as Path, Lines, optional Symbol, and Rationale fields."))
71: 	}
72: 	required := []string{"Sprint Scope", "Inspected Repository Areas", "Selected Source References", "Relationships", "Constraints", "Open Questions"}
73: 	headings := map[string]bool{}
74: 	for _, match := range codeContextHeadingRE.FindAllStringSubmatch(trimmed, -1) {
75: 		headings[strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(match[1]))] = true
76: 	}
77: 	for _, heading := range required {
78: 		if !headings[strings.ToLower(heading)] {
79: 			findings = append(findings, finding(heading, "", "", "missing required section", "the required level-two heading is absent", "Add a ## "+heading+" section with concrete content."))
80: 			continue
81: 		}
82: 		if strings.TrimSpace(sectionBody(trimmed, heading)) == "" {
83: 			findings = append(findings, finding(heading, "", "", "empty required section", "the required section has no content", "Add concrete inspected repository evidence to the section."))
84: 		}
85: 	}
86: 	selected := sectionBody(trimmed, "Selected Source References")
87: 	entries := codeContextEntries(selected)
88: 	if len(entries) == 0 {
89: 		findings = append(findings, finding("Selected Source References", "", "", "no selected source references", "at least one level-three selected entry is required", "Add at least one selected entry with repository-relative path, line range, and rationale."))
90: 	}
91: 	for _, entry := range entries {
92: 		pathMatch := codeContextPathRE.FindStringSubmatch(entry.body)
93: 		if len(pathMatch) != 2 || strings.TrimSpace(pathMatch[1]) == "" {
94: 			findings = append(findings, finding("Selected Source References", entry.name, "", "missing repository-relative path", "the entry has no Path field", "Add **Path:** with a repository-relative source path."))
95: 		} else if err := validateRepositoryRelativePath(strings.TrimSpace(pathMatch[1])); err != nil {
96: 			findings = append(findings, finding("Selected Source References", entry.name, strings.TrimSpace(pathMatch[1]), "unsafe source path", err.Error(), "Use a clean repository-relative path that does not escape the target."))
97: 		}
98: 		reason := codeContextReasonRE.FindStringSubmatch(entry.body)
99: 		if len(reason) != 2 || strings.TrimSpace(reason[1]) == "" {
100: 			findings = append(findings, finding("Selected Source References", entry.name, "", "missing rationale", "the entry does not explain why the reference matters", "Add a concrete **Rationale:** value."))
101: 		}
102: 		if lines := codeContextLinesRE.FindStringSubmatch(entry.body); len(lines) != 2 || strings.TrimSpace(lines[1]) == "" {
103: 			findings = append(findings, finding("Selected Source References", entry.name, "", "missing line range", "the entry has no Lines field", "Add **Lines:** with a positive line number or inclusive range so source can be injected later."))
104: 		} else {
105: 			if err := validateLineRange(strings.TrimSpace(lines[1])); err != nil {
106: 				findings = append(findings, finding("Selected Source References", entry.name, "", "malformed line range", err.Error(), "Use a positive line number or inclusive start-end range."))
107: 			}
108: 		}
109: 	}
110: 	sortSprintFindings(findings)
111: 	return findings
112: }

114: func containsCodeContextPlaceholder(content string) bool {
115: 	lower := strings.ToLower(content)
116: 	for _, placeholder := range []string{
117: 		"path/to/file.go",
118: 		"symbolname",
119: 		"describe the requirements-driven implementation scope",
120: 		"describe the packages, commands, boundaries, configuration, and tests inspected",
121: 		"explain why this source reference is relevant",
122: 		"describe how the selected code collaborates",
123: 		"record implementation constraints and invariants",
124: 		"record remaining source-level questions",
125: 	} {
126: 		if strings.Contains(lower, placeholder) {
127: 			return true
128: 		}
129: 	}
130: 	return false
131: }

133: type codeContextEntry struct{ name, body string }

135: func codeContextEntries(section string) []codeContextEntry {
136: 	matches := codeContextEntryRE.FindAllStringSubmatchIndex(section, -1)
137: 	out := make([]codeContextEntry, 0, len(matches))
138: 	for i, match := range matches {
139: 		end := len(section)
140: 		if i+1 < len(matches) {
141: 			end = matches[i+1][0]
142: 		}
143: 		out = append(out, codeContextEntry{name: strings.TrimSpace(section[match[2]:match[3]]), body: section[match[1]:end]})
144: 	}
145: 	return out
146: }

148: func sectionBody(content, heading string) string {
149: 	matches := codeContextHeadingRE.FindAllStringSubmatchIndex(content, -1)
150: 	for i, match := range matches {
151: 		if !strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(content[match[2]:match[3]]), heading) {
152: 			continue
153: 		}
154: 		end := len(content)
155: 		if i+1 < len(matches) {
156: 			end = matches[i+1][0]
157: 		}
158: 		return content[match[1]:end]
159: 	}
160: 	return ""
161: }

163: func validateRepositoryRelativePath(value string) error {
164: 	value = strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(value), "`")
165: 	if value == "" || filepath.IsAbs(value) || strings.Contains(value, `\`) || codeContextDriveRE.MatchString(value) {
166: 		return fmt.Errorf("path must be non-empty and relative")
167: 	}
168: 	clean := filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(filepath.FromSlash(value)))
169: 	if clean == "." || clean == ".." || strings.HasPrefix(clean, "../") || strings.ContainsAny(value, "\x00\r\n") {
170: 		return fmt.Errorf("path escapes or does not identify a source file")
171: 	}
172: 	return nil
173: }

175: func validateLineRange(value string) error {
176: 	value = strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(value), "`")
177: 	if value == "" {
178: 		return fmt.Errorf("range must contain at least one positive line number")
179: 	}
180: 	for _, segment := range strings.Split(value, ",") {
181: 		if err := validateSingleLineRange(strings.TrimSpace(segment)); err != nil {
182: 			return err
183: 		}
184: 	}
185: 	return nil
186: }

188: func validateSingleLineRange(value string) error {
189: 	parts := strings.Split(value, "-")
190: 	if len(parts) < 1 || len(parts) > 2 {
191: 		return fmt.Errorf("range %q must be N or N-M", value)
192: 	}
193: 	start, err := strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimSpace(parts[0]))
194: 	if err != nil || start < 1 {
195: 		return fmt.Errorf("range %q has an invalid start", value)
196: 	}
197: 	if len(parts) == 2 {
198: 		end, err := strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimSpace(parts[1]))
199: 		if err != nil || end < start {
200: 			return fmt.Errorf("range %q has an invalid end", value)
201: 		}
202: 	}
203: 	return nil
204: }

257: func (s Service) FlowCodeContext(ctx context.Context, projectRef, sprintRef string, req FlowRequest) (FlowResult, error) {
258: 	if req.To != StageCodeContext {
259: 		return FlowResult{}, fmt.Errorf("unsupported code-context flow target %q", req.To)
260: 	}
261: 	sp, inputs, _, err := s.resolveSprintInputsForFlow(projectRef, sprintRef, !req.DryRun)
262: 	if err != nil {
263: 		return FlowResult{}, err
264: 	}
265: 	now := s.now().UTC()
266: 	if findings := ValidateRequirementsContent(inputs.Requirements); len(findings) > 0 {
267: 		err := fmt.Errorf("code-context prerequisites failed validation")
268: 		return s.failCodeContext(sp, req, now, pruntime.Result{}, findings, err)
269: 	}
270: 	target, findings := s.resolveSprintTarget(sp, inputs.ProjectIndex, !req.DryRun)
271: 	if len(findings) > 0 {
272: 		err := fmt.Errorf("code-context target resolution failed")
273: 		return s.failCodeContext(sp, req, now, pruntime.Result{}, findings, err)
274: 	}
275: 	prompt := RenderCodeContextPrompt(s.root, sp, inputs.Requirements, target)
276: 	if req.DryRun {
277: 		return FlowResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, To: req.To, DryRun: true, Message: prompt.Prompt}, nil
278: 	}
279: 	if s.runtime == nil {
280: 		return s.failCodeContext(sp, req, now, pruntime.Result{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("runtime is required for code-context flow"))
281: 	}
282: 	candidate, err := os.CreateTemp(sp.Path, ".code-context.*.candidate.md")
283: 	if err != nil {
284: 		return s.failCodeContext(sp, req, now, pruntime.Result{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("create code-context candidate: %w", err))
285: 	}
286: 	candidatePath := candidate.Name()
287: 	if err := candidate.Close(); err != nil {
288: 		_ = os.Remove(candidatePath)
289: 		return s.failCodeContext(sp, req, now, pruntime.Result{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("close code-context candidate: %w", err))
290: 	}
291: 	defer os.Remove(candidatePath)
292: 	runtimeReq := s.runtimeRequest(prompt.Prompt, map[string]string{"project": sp.Project, "sprint": sp.Slug, "stage": string(StageCodeContext), "output_path": ArtifactRelPath(sp, StageCodeContext), "candidate_path": candidatePath, "target_source": target.Source})
293: 	if strings.TrimSpace(req.ModelOverride) != "" {
294: 		runtimeReq.Provider, runtimeReq.Model = splitProviderModel(strings.TrimSpace(req.ModelOverride))
295: 		runtimeReq.Metadata["model_source"] = "command override"
296: 	} else {
297: 		runtimeReq.Metadata["model_source"] = "effective configuration"
298: 	}
299: 	if strings.TrimSpace(req.VariantOverride) != "" {
300: 		runtimeReq.Metadata["variant"] = strings.TrimSpace(req.VariantOverride)
301: 		runtimeReq.Metadata["reasoning_effort"] = strings.TrimSpace(req.VariantOverride)
302: 		runtimeReq.Metadata["variant_source"] = "command override"
303: 	} else {
304: 		runtimeReq.Metadata["variant_source"] = "effective configuration"
305: 	}
306: 	runtimeReq.WorkDir = target.Path
307: 	runtimeReq.Sandbox = "read_only"
308: 	runtimeReq.Permissions = "restricted"
309: 	runtimeReq.Policy = pruntime.PermissionPolicy{Default: "deny", Tools: map[string]string{"read": "allow", "glob": "allow", "search": "allow", "list": "allow"}}
310: 	runtimeReq.RequireCaps = appendUniqueString(runtimeReq.RequireCaps, "permissions")
311: 	result, runErr := s.startPlanningStageRun(ctx, sp, StageCodeContext, runtimeReq)
312: 	if runErr != nil {
313: 		return s.failCodeContext(sp, req, now, result, validateCodeContextResult(result), runErr)
314: 	}
315: 	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
316: 		return s.failCodeContext(sp, req, now, result, nil, err)
317: 	}
318: 	if result.Permissions.UnsupportedCount > 0 {
319: 		return s.failCodeContext(sp, req, now, result, nil, fmt.Errorf("runtime cannot enforce required code-context read-only permission policy"))
320: 	}
321: 	if status := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(result.Status)); status != "" && status != "success" && status != "complete" && status != "completed" {
322: 		return s.failCodeContext(sp, req, now, result, nil, fmt.Errorf("code-context runtime ended with status %q", result.Status))
323: 	}
324: 	content := codeContextResultContent(result)
325: 	findings = ValidateCodeContextContent(content)
326: 	findings = append(findings, validateResolvedCodeContext(ctx, sp, inputs.Requirements, content, target.Path)...)
327: 	sortSprintFindings(findings)
328: 	result.Validation = pruntime.ValidationSummary{Configured: true, Passed: len(findings) == 0, Failures: len(findings)}
329: 	result.Repair = pruntime.RepairSummary{Configured: true, MaxAttempts: generatedArtifactRepairAttempts}
330: 	if len(findings) > 0 && result.SessionID != "" {
331: 		repairReq := runtimeReq
332: 		repairReq.Prompt = buildCodeContextRepairPrompt(ArtifactRelPath(sp, StageCodeContext), findings)
333: 		repairReq.SessionID = result.SessionID
334: 		repairReq.SessionAction = "continue"
335: 		repairReq.Metadata = cloneMetadata(repairReq.Metadata, map[string]string{"repair": "validation", "repair_artifact": ArtifactRelPath(sp, StageCodeContext)})
336: 		repaired, repairErr := s.startSprintRuntime(ctx, sp, StageCodeContext, repairReq)
337: 		repaired.Repair = pruntime.RepairSummary{Configured: true, Attempted: true, MaxAttempts: generatedArtifactRepairAttempts, AttemptCount: 1}
338: 		if repairErr != nil {
339: 			return s.failCodeContext(sp, req, now, repaired, findings, repairErr)
340: 		}
341: 		if err := codeContextRuntimeResultError(repaired); err != nil {
342: 			return s.failCodeContext(sp, req, now, repaired, nil, err)
343: 		}
344: 		result = repaired
345: 		content = codeContextResultContent(result)
346: 		findings = ValidateCodeContextContent(content)
347: 		findings = append(findings, validateResolvedCodeContext(ctx, sp, inputs.Requirements, content, target.Path)...)
348: 		sortSprintFindings(findings)
349: 		result.Validation = pruntime.ValidationSummary{Configured: true, Passed: len(findings) == 0, Failures: len(findings)}
350: 		if len(findings) > 0 {
351: 			result.Repair.Exhausted = true
352: 			result.Repair.ExhaustedReason = "validation findings remain after the bounded repair attempt"
353: 		}
354: 	}
355: 	if content != "" {
356: 		if err := os.WriteFile(candidatePath, []byte(content+"\n"), 0o644); err != nil {
357: 			return s.failCodeContext(sp, req, now, result, nil, fmt.Errorf("write code-context candidate: %w", err))
358: 		}
359: 	}
360: 	data, readErr := os.ReadFile(candidatePath)
361: 	if readErr != nil || len(strings.TrimSpace(string(data))) == 0 {
362: 		if readErr == nil {
363: 			readErr = errors.New("runtime returned no code-context output")
364: 		}
365: 		return s.failCodeContext(sp, req, now, result, nil, readErr)
366: 	}
367: 	findings = ValidateCodeContextContent(string(data))
368: 	findings = append(findings, validateResolvedCodeContext(ctx, sp, inputs.Requirements, string(data), target.Path)...)
369: 	sortSprintFindings(findings)
370: 	if len(findings) > 0 {
371: 		return s.failCodeContext(sp, req, now, result, findings, fmt.Errorf("generated code-context.md failed validation"))
372: 	}
373: 	if err := os.Chmod(candidatePath, 0o644); err != nil {
374: 		return s.failCodeContext(sp, req, now, result, nil, fmt.Errorf("set code-context candidate permissions: %w", err))
375: 	}
376: 	stages := flowCodeContextSuccessStages(sp, now)
377: 	prefix, prefixErr := renderSharedPromptContext(ctx, sp, inputs.Requirements, string(data), target.Path)
378: 	if prefixErr != nil {
379: 		return s.failCodeContext(sp, req, now, result, nil, prefixErr)
380: 	}
381: 	// Best effort only: the pack is derived and live resolution remains the
382: 	// authoritative fallback.
383: 	_ = saveContextPack(s.root, sp, inputs.Requirements, string(data), target.Path, prefix, now)
384: 	if err := s.promoteCodeContext(ctx, sp, candidatePath, NewFlowState(sp, stages, now)); err != nil {
385: 		return s.failCodeContext(sp, req, now, result, nil, err)
386: 	}
387: 	_ = s.cleanupPlanningStageSessions(ctx, sp, StageCodeContext, result)
388: 	return FlowResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, To: req.To, Runtime: result, Stages: stages, Message: "code-context complete"}, nil
389: }

427: func (s Service) failCodeContext(sp Sprint, req FlowRequest, now time.Time, result pruntime.Result, findings []ValidationFinding, err error) (FlowResult, error) {
428: 	stages := s.flowFailedStages(sp, StageCodeContext, err, now)
429: 	for i := range stages {
430: 		if stages[i].Stage == StageCodeContext {
431: 			stages[i].LatestOutcome = codeContextLatestOutcome(result, err)
432: 			break
433: 		}
434: 	}
435: 	if !req.DryRun {
436: 		if saveErr := SaveFlowState(s.root, sp, NewFlowState(sp, stages, now)); saveErr != nil {
437: 			err = errors.Join(err, fmt.Errorf("persist failed code-context outcome: %w", saveErr))
438: 		}
439: 	}
440: 	return FlowResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, To: req.To, DryRun: req.DryRun, Runtime: result, Stages: stages, Findings: findings}, err
441: }

443: func codeContextLatestOutcome(result pruntime.Result, err error) string {
444: 	if result.Cleanup.Failed || (result.Cleanup.Attempted && !result.Cleanup.Completed) {
445: 		return "cleanup_uncertain"
446: 	}
447: 	status := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(result.Status))
448: 	if errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) || status == "cancelled" || status == "canceled" {
449: 		return "cancelled"
450: 	}
451: 	if status == "interrupted" {
452: 		return "interrupted"
453: 	}
454: 	return "failed"
455: }

457: func (s Service) promoteCodeContext(ctx context.Context, sp Sprint, candidatePath string, state FlowState) error {
458: 	finalPath, err := ArtifactPath(s.root, sp, StageCodeContext)
459: 	if err != nil {
460: 		return err
461: 	}
462: 	old, oldErr := os.ReadFile(finalPath)
463: 	oldExists := oldErr == nil
464: 	if oldErr != nil && !os.IsNotExist(oldErr) {
465: 		return fmt.Errorf("read prior code-context artifact: %w", oldErr)
466: 	}
467: 	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
468: 		return err
469: 	}
470: 	if err := os.Rename(candidatePath, finalPath); err != nil {
471: 		return fmt.Errorf("promote code-context artifact: %w", err)
472: 	}
473: 	persistErr := ctx.Err()
474: 	if persistErr == nil {
475: 		persistErr = SaveFlowState(s.root, sp, state)
476: 	}
477: 	if persistErr != nil {
478: 		if oldExists {
479: 			restore, restoreErr := os.CreateTemp(sp.Path, ".code-context.*.restore.md")
480: 			if restoreErr == nil {
481: 				_, restoreErr = restore.Write(old)
482: 				if restoreErr == nil {
483: 					restoreErr = restore.Sync()
484: 				}
485: 				if closeErr := restore.Close(); restoreErr == nil {
486: 					restoreErr = closeErr
487: 				}
488: 				if restoreErr == nil {
489: 					restoreErr = os.Rename(restore.Name(), finalPath)
490: 				}
491: 				if restoreErr != nil {
492: 					_ = os.Remove(restore.Name())
493: 				}
494: 			}
495: 			if restoreErr != nil {
496: 				return fmt.Errorf("persist code-context state: %v; restore prior artifact: %w", persistErr, restoreErr)
497: 			}
498: 		} else {
499: 			_ = os.Remove(finalPath)
500: 		}
501: 		syncDir(sp.Path)
502: 		return fmt.Errorf("persist code-context state: %w", persistErr)
503: 	}
504: 	syncDir(sp.Path)
505: 	return nil
506: }

508: func appendUniqueString(values []string, value string) []string {
509: 	for _, current := range values {
